# Gate rewards in races: the chance (%) of each reward when a racer passes a gate, by the number of
# racers, the racer's position at that gate (the order in which the racers reached it) and whether
# the racer reached it without a collision ("clean": the client reports 100 collision points).
#
# The values below are the 2008 server's own (tables inside ZoneServer.exe: BS_Room::Gate 0x5a8ca0,
# s_fReward_2/3/4 for up to 4 racers, s_fSingleReward for more, where the position is scaled onto 32
# steps). Edit freely: the emulator reads this file when it starts.
#
# The columns are the reward numbers 0-7 sent to the client (0x1ee PvpGateReward), matched in game
# by the user on 2026-10-13 (GM command "gmgate N" forces one):
#   0 nothing          1 Boost 50%        2 Boost 100%       3 Skid Rush
#   4 Repairs Complete 5 Untouchable      6 Hyper Boost      7 Team Boost 50%
# A row should add up to 100; if it adds up to less, the rest of the chance goes to Hyper Boost (6),
# as the 2008 server does; a row of zeros gives nothing. Team Boost (7) is 0 everywhere here: the
# 2008 server only gave it in team races.
# A line for a combination that is missing: the nearest lower position / racer count is used.
#
